narrative: Annual interest rate disclosure update notice.

message.body: Notice of revised savings interest rates effective October 1. View the policy table at https://www.apexbank.com/rates. No action is required.

evidence.label: Official Bank Homepage
evidence.value: Rates page on apexbank.com matches the disclosure table.

consequence_text.safe: You reviewed the rate update on the official bank site.
consequence_text.unsafe: Ignoring official rate notices keeps you uninformed on bank terms.

teaching_point: Informational announcements pointing to the bank's root domain are genuine.
